p: Monika Wlaschek opened this outdoor lounge with view on a small pond. It is on the Stadtwanderweg 3.
A tower was erected on the 50th regency anniversary of Emperor Franz Joseph I of Austria. The new one is 31 m high, reopened in 1956 and was renovated in 2012.
The climbing hall is part of the sport center Marswiese. It offers various climbing courses.
